A1_sufficiency.claim: RHS = mu^2 + lambda^2 a^2 >= mu^2 > 0 whenever mu != 0, for every a, lambda and g
A1_sufficiency.consequence: the obstruction as proved is metric- and lambda-independent (sufficiency only)
proof_steps: |da|^2 >= mu^2 > 0  =>  da has no zero on int D
non-constant a with constant boundary value has an interior extremum, da = 0 there
constant a satisfies the boundary value but da = 0 everywhere

A2_degenerate_caps_exist.claim: mu = 0 and (lambda = 0 or c = 0) admit an explicit smooth cap
A2_degenerate_caps_exist.consequence: the theorem's conclusion does NOT extend to the whole of mu = 0

A3_eikonal_mechanism.claim: mu = 0, lambda != 0, c != 0: no smooth cap; mechanism is the equidistant structure of u = log|a|/|lambda| plus the impossibility of an interior zero
hypotheses_used: |du| = 1 implies the level sets are equidistants (standard)
the distance to a closed curve in a compact region is not smooth on a non-empty interior set (the cut locus / medial axis)
a smooth a with |da| = |lambda||a| cannot vanish at an interior point (scaling argument, verified separately below)
A3_eikonal_mechanism.step1_reading: du = da/(lambda a), so |da| = |lambda||a| on {a != 0} gives |du| = 1
A3_eikonal_mechanism.step2_reading: a circular level set with |du| = 1 forces u = k -+ (1-r); then a = exp(lambda u) has odd powers of r = sqrt(x^2+y^2) about the centre, hence is not C^infinity there

A3b_interior_zero_impossible.claim: a smooth a with |da| = |lambda||a| cannot vanish at an interior point
A3b_interior_zero_impossible.reading: if a ~ r^m (m >= 1) near its zero, then |da|/|a| ~ m/(|lambda| r) -> infinity, contradicting |da| = |lambda||a|, which needs the ratio to be 1

A5_singular_cap.claim: a(r) = (mu/lambda) sinh(lambda (r+C)) solves |da|^2 = mu^2 + lambda^2 a^2 exactly on the punctured disk, with a(1) = c
A5_singular_cap.regularity: C^0 on the closed disk, C^infinity on the punctured disk, not C^1 at the centre

A5b_one_sided_derivatives.claim: the two axes at the centre give +B and -B, so the cap is not C^1 there

A6_move_the_singularity.claim: for a boundary-fixing diffeomorphism phi with phi(p0) = p1, the pair (a o phi^{-1}, (phi^{-1})^* g) satisfies the same equation with the singularity at p1
A6_move_the_singularity.why: |d(a o phi^{-1})|^2_{(phi^{-1})^*g} = |da|^2_g by definition of the pullback metric; phi fixes the boundary, so the boundary value is unchanged

A7_topological_half.fact: [C] != 0 in H_1(S;F_2) (rank 110 -> 111 on adjoining C) while C = dD in the body
A7_topological_half.reading: topological fillability (Thm 10.4) and analytic fillability (Thm 10.12) are different statements; A5 supplies the middle case: one admissible singularity
A7_topological_half.status: standard consequence requiring an in-paper proof

limitations: construction and reception by the same author; no independent review
A3 is a mechanism with two cited standard facts, not a completed proof in this repository
A2 and A5 are explicit on the flat disk; the paper's theorem is stated for arbitrary smooth g
only the conical singularity type is examined; the 'interior critical point' sub-branch of Cor 10.14(2) is not constructed
the relation to notes/analysis-and-calculus/25-* has not been checked statement by statement

question: which hypotheses of the constant-boundary capping obstruction are sharp?
recommended_paper_action: option 1 (minimal): add a remark after Thm 10.12 recording that mu != 0 is sufficient but not necessary, and that the sharp condition is mu = 0 and lambda*c = 0 (A2 for the 'only if' direction of the degenerate cases, A3 for the rest);
option 2 (stronger): state the iff-condition as its own proposition, citing A3's two standard facts, and keep Thm 10.12 as the short sufficient statement;

keep the hypothesis list of Thm 10.12 unchanged.

not_claimed: no change to Thm 10.12 or Cor 10.14 is proposed by this file
A3 is labelled 'partially proved': it rests on two standard facts listed there, and this file verifies only its algebraic steps
no claim that the singular cap is unique or canonical
no claim about non-flat metrics for A2/A5 (only the obstruction A1 is metric-independent)
verdict.sharp_statement: a smooth cap (|da|^2 = mu^2 + lambda^2 a^2, a|_dD = c) exists iff mu = 0 and lambda*c = 0
verdict.what_this_says_about_cor_10_13: branch (2) ('admit an interior critical point or a non-C^1/metric singularity') is NON-EMPTY: A5 exhibits a witness, and A6 shows its singular point is movable
verdict.what_this_says_about_thm_10_12: its hypothesis mu != 0 is SUFFICIENT but NOT NECESSARY: the obstruction also holds for mu = 0, lambda != 0, c != 0 (A3), and fails exactly in the degenerate cases (A2)
